name: Waiting for Players
description: Players join and wait until the six-person cast is ready.

name: Role Assignment
description: Each player receives one unique village role.

name: Village Introductions
description: Introduce your public identity and hear the Lantern Keeper's opening account.
fallback_message: I am the Lantern Keeper. I witnessed the mountain's silence, and I will guide your search without deciding the truth for you. Six villagers, introduce your public identities in English. You may ask me privately for a clue at any stage, but keep every secret on your card hidden.

name: Investigation
description: Search the available places, inspect one object at a time, and submit deductions in English.

name: Discussion and Choice
description: Compare testimony, challenge the village's assumptions, and prepare a final answer. Searches are closed.

name: Final Village Decision
description: Vote on the response to the messenger's demand.

name: The Mountain's Answer
description: The host reconstructs what happened, reveals the village's choice, and explains every character's fate.
